abbreviation._instruction: Enter the official abbreviation of this common coordinate framework version.

anatomicalAxesOrientation._instruction: Add the axes orientation denoted in standard anatomical terms of direction (stated as XYZ) for the anatomical space of this common coordinate framework version.

axesOrigin._instruction: Enter the coordinate point in the native anatomical space of the template as [x, y] or [x, y, z] for two- or three-dimensional spaces, respectively, that has been defined as the origin of the anatomical space of this common coordinate framework version (i.e., as the central point where all axes intersect).

defaultImage._instruction: Add all image files used as visual representation of this common coordinate framework version.

digitalIdentifier._instruction: Add the globally unique and persistent digital identifier of this research product version.

isPrecededBy._instruction: Add the common coordinate framework version preceding this common coordinate framework version.

isVariantOf._instruction: Add all common coordinate framework versions that can be used alternatively to this common coordinate framework version.

isVersionOf._instruction: Add the version-independent information about this common coordinate framework.

nativeUnit._instruction: Add the native unit that is used for this common coordinate framework version.

ontologyIdentifier._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifiers (IRIs) to the related ontological terms matching this common coordinate framework version.

usedSpecimen._instruction: Add the specimen(s) that were used in the creation of this common coordinate framework version.
